_note: TSGO-ENHANCEMENT (since onerecord-fixes): upstream svelte-check --tsgo leaves a component the compiler parse() rejects out of the run with no diagnostic (its Svelte pass only visits files svelte2tsx converted), so the component checks clean and only the build fails. Default svelte-check reports the compiler parse error and counts the file; we now do the same, one error per rejected file at the first rejection, and still give it no overlay so its broken script cannot leak TypeScript noise. --disable-enhance restores the --tsgo behavior. Previously: The compiler's parse() rejects duplicate instance / module scripts, an invalid context attribute, a reserved script attribute (server) and a valued module attribute; svelte2tsx then throws and svelte-check drops the whole file, TypeScript errors included (E08, E09, E04, E05 carry TS errors that never surface). E10 is a valid <script module> whose TS error does surface. Verified against upstream svelte-check.
